<?php
$type=$_POST["type"];
$qte=$_POST["qte"];
$tel=$_POST["tel2"];
$psw=$_POST["psw1"];

mysql_connect("localhost","root","");
mysql_select_db("rafehmaddouripizza2020");
$req1="select * from client where (motpass==='$psw' and tel==='$tel') ";
$res1=mysql_query($req1);

if (mysql_num_rows($res1)!=0) 
{
	echo "N° Tél ou mot de passe erroné !";
}

else
{
    $date=date("d-m-Y H:i:s");

    $req2="insert into commande values('$type','$tel','$date','$qte')";
    $res2=mysql_query($req2);
		if (mysql_affected_rows()!=-1) {
			echo "client ajoutee avec success";
		}

}







?>
